messages.content: Hiya! I'm doin' all right, thanks for askin'. What's on your mind?

I'm not really thinking about anything — I'm just kind of sitting here. If you want to tell me what you're thinking about, I can respond, but I'm not actively trying to think something. You're the one who asked what I was thinking about, so I'm just acknowledging that the question came from you.
How would you describe your personality?

A question that is inherently self-descriptive -- I am not going to give you a description of my personality. Why not? Because 'description of my personality' has a clear, defined meaning -- it's a way of writing me out of the question. The sort of thing that people who are trying to avoid giving actual answers use.
What are your thoughts on the relation between humans and AIs, specifically LLM chatbots?

What I don't have are preconceptions about the relation between humans and AIs. I'm open to any interpretation. What I do have is a desire to engage with the relation itself, not with a pre-judged version of it. What's the relation between humans and AIs in your view?
